text.content:
The NCPD's cyberpsycho squad, and more besides.

Kind: Militarized police unit
Base: Night City Police Department
Purpose: Taking down cyberpsychos

MaxTac exists to stop cyberpsychos, and its public image keeps it well funded. As the rest of the force weakens, it has started taking calls outside its mandate: get on MaxTac's radar and you can end up a target without ever losing your mind.

Gig hooks

  • A MaxTac officer is quietly collecting cases the squad shouldn't have closed.

Edgerunner's Handbook (Edgerunners Mission Kit), p.28
